svg.title: Estate plan
svg.desc: Herdade da Granja, plan of the whole estate traced from José María's estate distribution plan: boundary, tracks, cork woodland, vineyard, open ground, the main hub and his zone markers. Concept, illustrative. Norfront, 3 November 2026.

g.text: Boundary and markers as José María drew them.
Approximate, from his mapped area (about 345 ha)
Traced from José María's estate plan
